header:
Why parking can be
a land bet

lines.text: Why pay over $53,000 per parking space?
lines.say: Why pay over fifty-three thousand dollars per parking space?

lines.text: In April 2026, Mobile Infrastructure announced it sold a 308-space Honolulu garage for $16.5 million. The buyer kept it for parking.
lines.say: In April twenty twenty-six, Mobile Infrastructure announced it sold a three hundred eight space Honolulu garage for sixteen point five million dollars. The buyer kept it for parking.

lines.text: In 2026, the company said its sales so far averaged about a 2% cap rate: $2 of yearly parking profit per $100 paid.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-six, the company said its sales so far averaged about a two percent cap rate: two dollars of yearly parking profit per hundred paid.

scene.label: Avg. cap rate, its sales so far

lines.text: It said buyers valued sites for development, campuses and strategic land.
lines.say: It said buyers valued sites for development, campuses and strategic land.

lines.text: Real estate once called cheap placeholders "taxpayers": they cover the tax while the land waits.
lines.say: Real estate once called cheap placeholders taxpayers: they cover the tax while the land waits.

lines.text: Example, at a 2% tax on full value: $2M of land costs $40,000 a year. Add a $20M building: $440,000.
lines.say: Example: at a two percent tax on full value, two million dollars of land costs forty thousand a year. Add a twenty million dollar building: four hundred forty thousand.

lines.text: Surface lots can play that role, since most US property taxes hit buildings too. On average, 22% of big-metro downtown land is parking.
lines.say: Surface lots can play that role, since most US property taxes hit buildings too. On average, twenty-two percent of big-metro downtown land is parking.

scene.label: Big-metro downtown land used for parking

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Why a Honolulu garage sold for $53,571 per space
post.ig:
Why pay over $53,000 per parking space?
In April 2026, Mobile Infrastructure announced it sold a 308-space Honolulu garage for $16.5 million; the buyer kept it for parking.
In 2026, the company said its sales so far averaged about a 2% cap rate on parking profit, with buyers valuing sites for development, campuses and land.
Example, at a 2% tax on full value: $2M of land costs $40,000 a year; add a $20M building and it's $440,000.
Sources: Mobile Infrastructure releases (Apr 2026), Parking Reform Network (2023), Lincoln Institute of Land Policy.
